description: What a person can do next (UX-06, WP-18) for each person-facing error code that is not in an errors.json catalogue (a catalogue entry carries its own nextAction): runErrors are the RUN_ERROR codes the web app words (run-error-codes.json), answerErrors the error answer codes (AnswerErrorCode), toolErrors the failed tool call codes (ToolErrorCode). Each value is a NextAction (core/error-catalog.schema.json): a kind a client can offer a control for, and plain English words. Each section names every code of its source, no more.

not_started.text: Nothing was done. Send your message again; if it keeps happening, ask your admin.

no_compatible_worker.text: No server here can run this kind of task right now. Ask your admin.

deadline_exceeded.text: The run took too long and stopped. Send your message again to try once more.

quarantined.text: The run kept failing and was stopped. Send your message again to try once more.

capability_lost.text: A tool or connection the agent needs went away. Try again; if it keeps happening, ask your admin.

mcp_tool_withdrawn.text: A connected app stopped offering a tool the run used. Send your message again to continue without it.

model_no_longer_configured.text: The model this conversation used is no longer set up. Send your message again to continue on a current model.

binary_mismatch.text: This agent's coding engine cannot run on this server right now. Ask your admin.

candidate_image.text: This agent's coding engine cannot run on this server right now. Ask your admin.

engine_unavailable.text: This agent's coding engine cannot run on this server right now. Ask your admin.

engine_image_missing.text: This agent's coding engine cannot run on this server right now. Ask your admin.

engine_contract_unsupported.text: This agent's coding engine cannot run on this server right now. Ask your admin.

gvisor_unavailable.text: Coding engines need the gVisor sandbox runtime on this server. Ask your admin to install it.

image_untrusted.text: This agent's sandbox image is not signed by a key this server trusts, so nothing was started. Ask your admin.

sandbox_unavailable.text: No sandbox was free, so nothing was done. Wait a few minutes, then try again.

store_unavailable.text: File storage could not be reached for several minutes, so the task stopped. Wait a few minutes, then try again.

engine_tools_unreachable.text: The coding engine could not reach PipesHub's tools. Send your message again; if it keeps happening, ask your admin.

event_flood.text: The coding engine sent far more updates than a task may and was stopped. Send your message again; if it keeps happening, ask your admin.

egress_volume_exceeded.text: This task moved more data than one task may here, so it stopped. Send a smaller request, or ask your admin about the limit.

secret_blocked.text: PipesHub blocked a request that looked like it contained a secret, so the task stopped. Remove the secret from your message or files and send it again.

worker_lost.text: The server running this task stopped, and this agent does not resume on its own, so the task ended. Send your message again to run it once more.

provider_unavailable.text: The AI model provider did not answer. Wait a few minutes, then try again.

rate_limited.text: The AI model provider is limiting requests. Wait a few minutes, then try again.

operator_stopped.text: Your admin stopped this agent work for now. Ask your admin, or send your message again once they resume it.

out_of_memory.text: This task ran out of memory and was stopped. Send a smaller task, or ask your admin about the coding engine's memory.

content_filter.text: The provider's content filter blocked the request. Rephrase your question, or start a new chat and try again.

quota_exceeded.text: The model's account is out of credit. Ask your admin to top it up or pick another model.

rate_limit.text: The model's provider is limiting requests. Wait a minute, then try again.

auth_error.text: The model's provider rejected its key. Ask your admin to check the key in AI Models.

model_not_found.text: The provider could not find this model. Ask your admin to check the model name and endpoint in AI Models.

request_too_large.text: The conversation is too long for this model. Shorten your message or start a new chat.

invalid_request.text: The model rejected the request. Ask your admin to check the model settings in AI Models.

server_error.text: The model's provider is not responding. Wait a minute, then try again.

timeout.text: The model took too long to answer. Try again.

unknown.text: Something went wrong while answering. Try again; if it keeps happening, ask your admin.

needs_reconciliation.text: An action may have happened before its result was saved. Ask your admin to check it before the task can go on.

deadline_exceeded.text: The run took too long and stopped. Send your message again to try once more.

approval_expired.text: Nobody approved the action in time, so it was not taken. Send your message again to try once more.

budget_exhausted.text: The reply reached its spending limit. Ask your admin to raise the limit, or ask for less at a time.

budget_insufficient.text: Too little budget was left for the next step. Ask your admin to raise the limit, or ask for less at a time.

unavailable.text: Nothing to do: the agent carries on without this tool and says what it could not reach.

timeout.text: Nothing to do: the agent carries on without this answer and says what it could not get.

rate_limited.text: Nothing to do: the agent carries on and may try the tool again later.

auth.text: Connect the app again, or ask your admin to check its connection.

not_found.text: Nothing to do: the agent is told what it asked for does not exist and carries on.

invalid_call.text: Nothing to do: the agent is told it called the tool wrongly and can try again.

failed.text: Nothing to do: the agent carries on without this result and says what failed.
